name: Porcelain Tiara
description: Opera helmets are the collective name for various hats worn by drama actors, and their production techniques are included in the national intangible cultural heritage representative items. Pinku combines the skills of helmet making with the art of Peking Opera. It uses the phoenix crown of Concubine Yang in Peking Opera and the blue and white vase exclusive to the beloved concubine to create a "blue and white opera crown", using metal pieces to inherit the quintessence of Chinese "top" kung fu.
